intro: Want your own website running on Linux? In about a minute, we'll install engine-x, one of the most popular web servers in the world, and publish a page of our own.
install: First, open a terminal and install engine-x with the package manager.
installed: Done. It downloaded engine-x and set it up in just a few seconds.
start: Let's check the version, then start the server.
browser: Now switch to the browser and visit localhost. There it is. engine-x is serving its welcome page.
write: Back in the terminal, we replace the default page with our own. A single line of HTML is all it takes.
reload: Reload the browser, and our page is live.
verify: Finally, let's confirm from the command line that the server answers with two hundred OK.
outro: That's it. Install, start, publish. You just hosted a website on Linux. Thanks for watching!
